question: Do I need to book in advance
answer: Yes class spaces are limited and some sessions fill quickly so advance booking is recommended

question: How do I know if a class is full
answer: StudioFlow AI checks the latest class data and can tell you whether spaces are available whether the class is full or whether a waitlist is open

question: Are beginners welcome
answer: Yes we offer several beginner-friendly classes and coaches can be explored by specialty and experience focus

question: What should I bring to my first class
answer: Bring water comfortable training clothes and grip socks for reformer Pilates if you have them

question: How early should I arrive
answer: Please arrive 10 minutes before your first class so the coach can welcome you and answer any questions

question: Can I cancel a class
answer: Yes cancellations are allowed up to 12 hours before class start time otherwise the class may be deducted from your package

question: Do you have showers or changing rooms
answer: Yes we have changing rooms lockers and two showers on site

question: Can I join if I have not exercised in a while
answer: Yes beginner-friendly options are available and you can ask about suitable coaches and classes before choosing

question: Do memberships renew automatically
answer: Monthly memberships renew automatically until cancelled according to the membership terms

question: Is parking available
answer: There is limited street parking nearby and a public car park two minutes from the studio
